whoItSuits: Favored by runners, gym athletes, trekkers, parents making colourful nutrient-rich rotis and baby meals (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician), and natural skin/hair mask enthusiasts.
monsoonStorage: Beetroot contains natural root sugars that pull moisture from humid air. Keep the glass jar tightly closed in a cool, dark cupboard away from stove steam, and always scoop with a dry spoon.
